algorithms.hvg_pca_elastic_net: multinomial elastic-net logistic regression; C=1; l1_ratio=0.5; SAGA; max_iter=5000
algorithms.hvg_pca_knn: 15-neighbor Euclidean vote in PCA space; votes use donor/class-balanced training weights; canonical-row tie break
algorithms.hvg_pca_linear_svm: linear SVM; C=1; donor-grouped three-fold out-of-fold score calibration by multinomial L2 logistic regression
algorithms.hvg_pca_logistic: multinomial L2 logistic regression; C=1; LBFGS; max_iter=5000
algorithms.hvg_pca_nearest_centroid: donor/class-weighted class centroids; squared Euclidean distance; training-derived softmax temperature

common_preprocessing.feature_selection: training-only rank-binned normalized dispersion; 20 mean bins; top 2000; Ensembl-ID tie break
common_preprocessing.normalization: per-cell library-size scaling to 10000 followed by log1p
common_preprocessing.pca: training-only centered full SVD; at most 50 components
common_preprocessing.prediction: held-donor fold only; complete class probabilities; no observed label
common_preprocessing.split: SHA256(split_seed NUL donor_id), first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 5
common_preprocessing.training_weights: equal class mass, then equal donor mass within class, rescaled to training cell count
